When a partial update (e.g. only firstName) omits `photo`, the field is undefined, so photo is set to null. That null is passed to the repository, and the mapper turns it into a null relation, which clears the avatar. The check should be `=== null`, because null is the explicit request to remove the photo. Compare the create path at lines 72-73, which uses `=== null`.

fix.description: Change the condition from `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` to `updateUserDto.photo === null`. An omitted photo then stays undefined and is left unchanged. Only an explicit null clears it.
